title: Generative modeling with sparse transformers
summary: We’ve developed the Sparse Transformer, a deep neural network which sets new records at predicting what comes next in a sequence—whether text, images, or sound. It uses an algorithmic improvement of the attention mechanism to extract patterns from sequences 30x longer than possible previously.
body: We’ve developed the Sparse Transformer, a deep neural network which sets new records at predicting what comes next in a sequence—whether text, images, or sound. It uses an algorithmic improvement of the attention mechanism to extract patterns from sequences 30x longer than possible previously.
summaryZh: OpenAI开发了稀疏Transformer（Sparse Transformer），这是一种通过对注意力机制进行算法改进来预测文本、图像或声音序列的深度神经网络。该架构成功将序列处理长度提升至此前30倍，能够从极长的上下文序列中提取复杂模式并创下预测新纪录。

glossary.explanationZh: 采用稀疏注意力机制以处理极长序列的变体Transformer模型。
允许模型在序列中动态聚焦于相关部分的核心神经网络机制。
旨在学习数据分布以生成新样本的机器学习建模方法。
